topology: One Node process using ClusterWorkflowEngine.layer + SingleRunner.layer({ runnerStorage: 'sql' }) + a local SQLite database; no Docker or separate server
measurementLimits: Measurements were made on a concurrently busy development Mac and are not directly comparable to other candidate trials.
The sample excludes the Strands harness, A2A listener, provider clients, and actual factory workload.
The local SQLite database and installed package tree are separate from a packaged product footprint.
The duplicate-signal trial does not establish exactly-once external effects or multi-host concurrency.
